Leo keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. Leo believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What's more, the cake is topped with red cherries.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around Leo often share different ideas about the temple fair. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. An annulment erases the marriage legally.

At first, Leo found it difficult to keep the habit. Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The family dinner table has become an important part of daily life. For example, their argument ended with laughter.
Little by little, things began to change. Leo wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Owen advised Leo to try cooking as a new hobby. The runny egg yolk soaked perfectly into the hot rice.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Owen and Leo are preparing a report about the temple fair. On Saturday evenings, Leo reviews the notes from class.
